question: How many moving objects are in each video?
sql: SELECT v.filename AS filename, COUNT(o.object_id) AS moving_objects FROM videos v LEFT JOIN objects o ON o.video_id = v.video_id GROUP BY v.video_id ORDER BY v.filename

question: Which video has the most activity?
sql: SELECT v.filename AS filename, COUNT(o.object_id) AS moving_objects FROM videos v LEFT JOIN objects o ON o.video_id = v.video_id GROUP BY v.video_id ORDER BY moving_objects DESC

question: When is each video busiest?
sql: WITH RECURSIVE s(t) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT t + 1 FROM s WHERE t < 3600), occ AS (SELECT o.video_id AS video_id, s.t AS second, COUNT(*) AS active_tracks FROM s JOIN objects o ON o.first_seen_s <= s.t AND o.last_seen_s >= s.t GROUP BY o.video_id, s.t) SELECT v.filename AS filename, occ.second AS second, occ.active_tracks AS active_tracks FROM occ JOIN videos v ON v.video_id = occ.video_id WHERE occ.active_tracks = (SELECT MAX(o2.active_tracks) FROM occ o2 WHERE o2.video_id = occ.video_id) GROUP BY occ.video_id ORDER BY v.filename

question: What are the longest tracks?
sql: SELECT v.filename AS filename, o.track_id AS track_id, ROUND(o.last_seen_s - o.first_seen_s, 2) AS seconds_visible, o.first_seen_s AS first_seen_s, o.last_seen_s AS last_seen_s FROM objects o JOIN videos v ON v.video_id = o.video_id ORDER BY seconds_visible DESC LIMIT 5

question: How confident are the detections?
sql: SELECT v.filename AS filename, ROUND(AVG(o.confidence), 3) AS mean_confidence, ROUND(MIN(o.confidence), 3) AS min_confidence, ROUND(MAX(o.confidence), 3) AS max_confidence FROM objects o JOIN videos v ON v.video_id = o.video_id GROUP BY o.video_id ORDER BY v.filename

question: What needs review?
sql: SELECT r.review_id AS review_id, v.filename AS filename, r.video_id AS video_id, r.segment_id AS segment_id, r.reason AS reason, r.status AS status FROM review_queue r JOIN videos v ON v.video_id = r.video_id ORDER BY r.created_at_utc, r.review_id
